detection_pack.sigma:
title: APEX - CVE-2026-61518: ISPConfig contains an authenticated SQL inje — SQL Injection
id: apex-sqli-0dc12c9f
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects SQL injection exploitation attempts for CVE-2026-61518. Covers classic, blind, time-based, error-based, and UNION-based SQLi attack patterns in web request parameters and URI queries.
  Generated by CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX v184.0
references:
    - https://intel.cyberdudebivash.com
    - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-61518
author: CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX
date: 2026/10/30
tags:
    - attack.initial_access
    - attack.t1190
    - attack.t1059.001
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  sqli_union_based:
    cs-uri-query|contains:
      - 'UNION+SELECT'
      - 'UNION%20SELECT'
      - 'UNION/**/SELECT'
      - 'UNION%0ASELECT'
  sqli_boolean_based:
    cs-uri-query|contains:
      - "' OR '1'='1"
      - "' OR 1=1--"
      - "1' AND 1=1--"
      - "' OR 'x'='x"
      - "admin'--"
      - "1' OR '1'='1"
  sqli_time_based:
    cs-uri-query|contains:
      - 'SLEEP('
      - 'WAITFOR DELAY'
      - 'BENCHMARK('
      - 'pg_sleep('
      - '; SELECT SLEEP'
  sqli_stacked_queries:
    cs-uri-query|contains:
      - '; DROP TABLE'
      - '; INSERT INTO'
      - '; UPDATE '
      - '; EXEC '
      - 'xp_cmdshell'
      - 'EXEC(CHAR'
  condition: sqli_union_based or sqli_boolean_based or sqli_time_based or sqli_stacked_queries
falsepositives:
  - URL-encoded legitimate content containing SQL-like keywords
  - Security scanner automated SQL injection testing
  - UNION appearing in legitimate application query strings
level: high
detection_pack.spl:
| comment "CVE-2026-61518: ISPConfig contains an authenticated SQL inje | CVE-2026-61518 | APEX v184.0"

| comment "SQLi detection from web logs"
index=web earliest=-24h
| eval is_sqli = if(match(uri_query, "UNION.{0,10}SELECT|' OR '1'='1|SLEEP\(|xp_cmdshell"), 1, 0)
| where is_sqli=1
index=network OR index=proxy earliest=-24h
| eval threat_match = if(match(_raw, "(?i)(CVE\-2026\-61518)"), 1, 0)
| where threat_match=1
| eval rule="APEX-CVE-2026-61518", severity="HIGH"
| stats count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by src_ip, dest_host, rule, severity
| convert timeformat="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ" ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
| sort -count
detection_pack.yara:
rule APEX_CVE_2026_61518__SQLI {
    meta:
        description   = "APEX detection: CVE-2026-61518: ISPConfig contains an authenticated SQL injection vuln"
        cve           = "CVE-2026-61518"
        vuln_class    = "SQLI"
        author        = "CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX v184.0"
        date          = "2026-10-30"
        reference     = "https://intel.cyberdudebivash.com"
        severity      = "high"
        mitre_attack  = "T1190.001, T1190, T1059"
    strings:
        $sqli_union = "UNION SELECT" ascii wide nocase  // SQLi UNION-based
        $sqli_sleep = "SLEEP(" ascii wide nocase  // SQLi time-based
        $sqli_xp = "xp_cmdshell" ascii wide nocase  // SQLi stacked MSSQL
        $sqli_blind = "1=1--" ascii wide nocase  // SQLi boolean blind
    condition:
        2 of them
}

index=* earliest=-90d latest=now

| stats count AS hits,
    min(_time) AS first_seen,

       last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
| sort - hits
retro_hunt.qradar_aql:
/* RETRO-HUNT AQL: intel--e348c8c1c75ff1b6 | Lookback: 90d */
SELECT
    DATEFORMAT(devicetime,'YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS EventTime,
    sourceip, destinationip, destinationhostname,
    username, "Application", "Event Category",
    LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) AS LogSource,
    QIDNAME(qid) AS EventName,
    'intel--e348c8c1c75ff1b6' AS HuntAdvisoryID
FROM events

    destinationip IN ('<ip>')

    OR destinationhostname IN ('<domain>')

)
AND devicetime > (NOW() - 7776000)
ORDER BY devicetime DESC
LIMIT 10000
START '90d ago'
STOP 'now'

retro_hunt.generic_sql:
/* RETRO-HUNT Generic SQL: intel--e348c8c1c75ff1b6 | Lookback: 90d */
/* Compatible with: Splunk Data Lake, Snowflake, BigQuery, Azure Data Explorer */
SELECT
    event_timestamp,
    host_name,
    source_ip,
    destination_ip,
    destination_domain,
    file_hash_sha256,
    process_name,
    process_command_line,
    user_name,
    'intel--e348c8c1c75ff1b6' AS hunt_advisory_id
FROM security_events
WHERE event_timestamp > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '90 days'
  AND (
    destination_ip IN ('<ip>')
    OR source_ip IN ('<ip>')
    OR destination_domain IN ('<domain>')

  )
ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC
